posts.title: An Update to My Essay of June 2020
Tacklebox
posts.description: After looking at my own cantilever toolbox from various angles, it was clear that a side view would make for the strongest silhouette. From this perspective, it was possible to depict the subject using very simple geometry, with the curves of the box nesting neatly within the corners of the app icon shape. Proud to say I commissioned this one!

posts.title: Touch on the Mac Sands Down Rough Edges
posts.description: Why do so many people ask for built-in cellular support on the Mac? Macs already have cellular support via Personal Hotspot on your iPhone. It’s easy enough to enable via the Wi-Fi menu. So why keep asking for it? Because it would be nicer . You wouldn’t have to connect to your phone each time you reopen your laptop.
